news.title: AI agents are running hospital records and factory inspections. Enterprise IAM was never built for them.
news.summary_raw: A doctor in a hospital exam room watches as a medical transcription agent updates electronic health records, prompts prescription options, and surfaces patient history in real time. A computer vision agent on a manufacturing line is running quality control at speeds no human inspector can match. Both generate non-human identities that most enterprises cannot inventory, scope, or revoke at machine speed.That is the structural problem keeping agentic AI stuck in pilots. Not model capability. Not c
news.summary: AI transcription and computer vision agents are being used to update hospital records and factory inspections, highlighting challenges with inventorying and revoking non-human identities generated by these agents. This issue lies in the underlying architecture of enterprise IAM systems, which were not designed to handle these new types of entities.
news.enterprise_use: Check the identity and access management systems in your organization to ensure they can handle the unique challenges posed by agentic AI. Failing to do so may leave your organization vulnerable to security risks as non-human identities proliferate. This requires a closer look at tools like Google Workspace, JumpCloud, and Freshservice.
